lines.1: 「Yoshimi, do we have a roster of all the first-years?」
lines.4: 「The reference materials are on this shelf, so feel free to look through them.」
lines.5: The student council really did have everything on file.
lines.6: 「Put it back where you found it when you're done. Or you can just return it to me.」
lines.8: The brisk clatter of touch-typing had been going on for some time.
lines.9: The Princess was putting some kind of document together.
lines.11: 「So the plan is to look at the first-year roster and pick someone at random?」
lines.13: 「Look. It even lists every club they're in.」
lines.14: 「First-years in sports clubs won't have any free time under Ryuumeikan's strict hierarchy.」
lines.15: 「We can rule people out that way, then choose from the names left over.」
lines.16: 「Sounds good. Not to show off my learning or anything, but you know what they say: a name lays the body bare.」
lines.18: 「Crab, you need to study more. And the saying is, 'The name reveals the nature.'」
